components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clearest next step on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #286044); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--accent, #286044); color: #fff; font: 750 14px Corbel, Calibri, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(35,77,56,.18); transition: background .15s, border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-dark, #19472f); border-color: var(--accent-dark, #19472f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e0a800; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Soft Action Button
components.description: A secondary or selected action that stays within the green family.
components.css: .ds-btn-soft { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #b7cdbd; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent-soft, #e5efe7); color: var(--accent-dark, #19472f); font: 750 13px Corbel, Calibri, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-soft:hover { border-color: #91b09b; background: #d9e8dc; } .ds-btn-soft:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e0a800; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A restrained destructive action that never competes with the primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #d7aaa2; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--danger, #ad493a); font: 750 13px Corbel, Calibri, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { border-color: var(--danger, #ad493a); background: #fbefed; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e0a800; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A crisp field set inside a warm cream panel.
components.html: <input class="ds-input-search" value="Memento" aria-label="Search by film title">
components.css: .ds-input-search { width: 280px; height: 48px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #aaa99e; border-radius: 11px; background: #fff; color: var(--text, #1b2921); font: 14px Corbel, Calibri, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input-search:hover { border-color: #7d8b82; } .ds-input-search:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #286044); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,98,72,.13); outline: 0; }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: Compact neutral context for years, ratings, dates, and counts.
components.css: .ds-chip-meta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; padding: 5px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--background, #f5f1e8); color: #526057; font: 700 12px Corbel, Calibri, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

components.name: Film Card
components.css: .ds-film-card { width: 220px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(216,208,194,.9); border-radius: 18px; background: var(--surface, #fffdfa); color: var(--text, #1b2921); box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(48,51,39,.08); font-family: Corbel, Calibri, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-film-card:hover { border-color: #c7bcaa; box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(48,51,39,.12); } .ds-film-card:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #e0a800; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-film-poster { aspect-ratio: 2/3; background: #e8eae7; } .ds-film-copy { display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 18px 17px; } .ds-film-copy strong { font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-film-copy span { color: #526057; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Header Control
components.description: Compact navigation control shared by the Watchlist selector, management action, and profile.
components.css: .ds-header-control { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #ddd7ca); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--surface, #fffdfa); color: var(--muted, #6a716a); font: 700 14px Corbel, Calibri, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-header-control:hover { border-color: #b8b2a6; color: var(--text, #1b2921); } .ds-header-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #e0a800; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Insieme should feel like settling into a familiar room with someone you trust: warm enough to invite lingering, orderly enough to make a decision, and never so styled that the interface becomes the event. Cream surfaces, forest-green actions, dark ink, and the small flower mark create a domestic visual language without becoming rustic or nostalgic.

The system is friendly and tactile. Controls have comfortable targets, modest curves, clear borders, and immediate state changes. Density stays practical: film imagery carries visual energy while surrounding controls remain calm. Avoid cold dashboard styling, ornamental excess, and novelty that slows the shared decision.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper-like neutrals with deep green action color.
Friendly, tactile controls with restrained rounded geometry.
Film posters provide the strongest color and visual contrast.
Clear hierarchy and compact supporting information.
Small floral color accents are rare, recognizable brand punctuation.

rules.name: The Poster Leads Rule
rules.body: UI colors stay restrained so film artwork remains the most chromatic content on the page.

rules.name: The Flower Is Punctuation Rule
rules.body: Pink and gold belong to the flower mark; do not spread them across routine buttons, badges, or status messages.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce a display typeface to manufacture personality; the existing humanist family and film imagery already carry the voice.

rules.name: The Decision Path Rule
rules.body: Preserve the order of discovery, shortlist, and watched history. Layout changes may compress that path but must not obscure it.

rules.name: The Ambient Layer Rule
rules.body: Shadows create separation and focus; they never become decoration or imitate floating glass.

rules.name: The Curves Follow Scale Rule
rules.body: Larger containers receive larger radii; do not apply pill shapes to ordinary buttons, inputs, cards, or dialogs.

dos: Do let film imagery carry most of the page's color and visual drama.
Do use Forest Action for the clearest next step and Forest Mist for secondary or selected states.
Do preserve warm borders even when an ambient shadow separates a surface.
Do keep metadata compact, readable, and visually subordinate to titles.
Do transform dense dialogs into bottom sheets and poster cards into horizontal rows on small screens.
donts: Don't turn the interface into a cold analytics dashboard or generic SaaS shell.
Don't use gradients, glass effects, glow shadows, or decorative floating shapes.
Don't distribute the flower's pink and gold across routine UI controls.
Don't add rounded containers around content that already has a clear grouping relationship.
Don't animate for personality alone; motion should explain state, collapse, or spatial transition.
Don't compete with poster artwork through loud UI color or ornamental typography.
